MODELS AND NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW

 MOSS-Image needs ComfyUI 0.42.0 or newer, the first version with MOSS. On an older ComfyUI, Load CLIP has no moss_image type: update ComfyUI first.

 Load Diffusion Model

Download moss_image_sft_int8_convrot.safetensors5.41 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/moss

Create the moss folder if it does not exist.

Take the file with sft in its name: that is the finished model. The base files are the raw model, made for training LoRAs.

 Load CLIP

Download qwen3.5_9b_w4a8_gptq.safetensors7.34 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders

 Load VAE

Download flux2-vae_small.safetensors250 MB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/vae

This is the small Flux 2 VAE, a different file from flux2-vae.safetensors.

 License

MOSS-Image is made by OpenMOSS and released under the Apache 2.0 license: you may use the pictures and the model commercially.

MOSS-Image model card 

 After placing the files, restart ComfyUI or refresh model lists using the R shortcut.

 Nodes Installed from Manager

  • Pixaroma: update to the latest version (these workflows need at least 1.4.219). A node shows red or missing? Update Pixaroma.

Which version is the newest? The Latest Pixaroma version button shows it and what is new in it. The help page has the update steps for every kind of install.

Latest Pixaroma version How to update Pixaroma 

 Something missing?

Each button opens a short video that shows the fix, with the steps written under it.

Red or missing nodes A model file is missing Buttons missing after an update 

 Resources

Join Discord  Pixaroma YouTube Channel  Ask for help

{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

Draw boxes to say WHERE each thing goes, and MOSS puts it in its box. A Text box puts its exact words there, in the style you describe. Good for posters, covers, cards and product shots.

 Steps

  1. Pick the picture size on Sizes Pixaroma: the box canvas takes the same shape.
  2. On Layout Boxes Pixaroma, move or resize the boxes, or draw new ones. For each box choose Obj or Text, describe it, and for a Text box type the exact words.
  3. In Prompt Pixaroma, describe the whole picture: the kind of picture, the style, the colours and the light.
  4. Leave the seed on F to repeat a picture, or switch it to R for a new one every Run.
  5. Press Run. Show Text Pixaroma shows what MOSS got.

 Writing the boxes and the prompt

  • Give each box one full description: an amber glass serum bottle with a black dropper cap on a round travertine stone pedestal. Colours go in the words: the box colour on the canvas is only for you.
  • A Text box gets its exact words in its text field and a short description of the letters: a clean thin dark brown modern sans-serif headline, wide letter spacing. Size the box to the words: a long line needs a wide box.
  • The prompt describes the whole picture: the kind of picture, the style, the background, the colours. You do not need to name the boxes in it: the hint under the boxes about <obj_1> tags is for FLUX 3, MOSS gets the boxes from MOSS-Image Layout Prompt.
  • Boxes are guides, not cut-outs: an object fills its box roughly, with its own shape and shadow.

 More to try

The second example from the video: a perfume ad with 4 boxes drawn from zero (size 896 x 1152, seed 1). Press Clear on Layout Boxes Pixaroma, then draw:

  1. Text, wide across the top: ORVELLE, described as an elegant thin gold serif wordmark with wide letter spacing.
  2. Obj, tall, left of the middle: a faceted crystal-clear glass perfume bottle filled with pale pink perfume, with a heavy polished gold cap, standing on a dark green marble slab.
  3. Obj, right of the bottle: one large pink king protea flower with silvery-pink petals, lying on the marble slab beside the bottle.
  4. Text, small at the bottom: EAU DE PARFUM - 50 ML, described as small gold sans-serif capitals with wide letter spacing.

And in Prompt Pixaroma:

A luxury perfume advertisement photographed on a deep emerald green background with a soft round glow of light behind the bottle. A faceted crystal-clear glass perfume bottle with pale pink perfume and a polished gold cap stands on a dark green marble slab, one large pink king protea flower lies beside it, an elegant gold wordmark sits at the top and a small gold line at the bottom. Soft warm light from camera-left draws crisp highlights on the glass facets and the gold cap, with a soft contact shadow on the marble.

 Good to know

  • Tested on posters and ads with 3 boxes (2 Text, 1 Obj: this serum ad, a burger ad, a sneaker poster, a headphones ad, a concert poster) and on a still life with 3 objects: everything landed in its box on every seed we tried, and the words came out right.
  • Want a person or a character in a box? Type its number in character_boxes on MOSS-Image Layout Prompt: MOSS then treats it as a character, not an object. Our YouTube-thumbnail test with a cartoon bunny worked that way.
  • Keep the seed and change only the words in a Text box: you get the same picture with the new words (tested on a poster and a cafe chalkboard). Workflow 6 shows a faster way to make many versions.
  • The boxes are stored as parts of the canvas, so they stay in place when you pick another size. A different SHAPE stretches them with the canvas: check them after you change the shape.
  • ComfyUI also has its own box node, Create Bounding Boxes, but its canvas only shows in Nodes 2.0. Layout Boxes Pixaroma works in both looks and gives MOSS exactly the same boxes.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Save to your own folder Nodes look different from the video

{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load Diffusion Model (MOSS-Image SFT) - The image model, MOSS-Image SFT from OpenMOSS: a 5B text-to-image model that is very good at words in pictures and can follow a layout of boxes. The int8 file (5.4 GB) looks the same as the 10 GB bf16 file in our tests.
  • Load CLIP (Qwen 3.5 9B, reads the prompt) - Reads your prompt and turns the words into something MOSS understands. The type must be moss_image.
  • Load VAE (Flux 2 VAE small) - Turns the finished render into a picture. MOSS uses the small Flux 2 VAE, a different file from the normal flux2-vae.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Sizes Pixaroma (1. picture size) - The picture size. The demo is 896 x 1152. It also sets the shape of the box canvas, so the boxes always match the picture. Its latent output is the blank canvas MOSS paints on, straight into the KSampler (ComfyUI's own KSampler: a sampler from another node pack can make the picture twice too big).
  • Layout Boxes Pixaroma (2. draw where each thing goes) - The layout canvas, the shape of your picture. Each box is one thing: an Obj box for an object or a person, a Text box for words, with their exact text. Drag a box to move it, drag its corner to resize it, draw a new one for a new thing; the big-view button opens it larger.
  • Prompt Pixaroma (3. the whole picture) - The whole picture in a few sentences: the kind of picture, the style, the colours, the light. The boxes add WHERE each thing goes.
  • Seed Pixaroma (4. fixed or random) - The seed. F (fixed) gives the same picture every Run, R (random) a new one each Run. The demo uses seed 1.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • MOSS-Image Layout Prompt (adds the boxes) - ComfyUI's own MOSS node: it puts your prompt and the boxes together into the layout MOSS was trained on (each box with its kind, its description, its words and its place in pixels). Leave character_boxes empty, or type the numbers of the boxes that are people or characters (like 1, 3).
  • CLIP Text Encode (reads the prompt) - Reads the prompt through the text encoder.
  • CLIP Text Encode (negative prompt) - The negative prompt from ComfyUI's own MOSS workflow and the MOSS user guide: nsfw, worst quality, bad anatomy, watermark, jpeg artifact. Leave it as it is.
  • Skip Layer Guidance (from ComfyUI's MOSS workflow) - A setting from ComfyUI's own MOSS workflow and the MOSS user guide: it skips layer 22 in the negative half of the first half of the steps. Leave it as it is.
  • KSampler (25 steps) - The render: 25 steps, CFG 2.5, er_sde, simple, the settings of ComfyUI's own MOSS workflow.
  • VAE Decode (latent to picture) - Turns the finished render into a picture.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (saves the picture) - Saves each picture as PNG into ComfyUI/output/MOSS Image Layout and shows it on the node.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Show Text Pixaroma (the prompt MOSS gets) - Shows what MOSS actually gets: your prompt as the summary, then every box with its description, words and position.
  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Nodes Info","icon":"node-v5","color":"#3d7cc9"}}

widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the number of pictures and their size.

SizeTime
896 x 1152 (the demo)about 9 s
Full HD, 1088 x 1920about 16 s

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models from disk (MOSS and its text encoder, about 13 GB together), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.
